title: Achieving accurate estimates of fetal gestational age and personalised predictions of fetal growth based on data from an international prospective cohort study: a population-based machine learning study
summary: A machine-learning fetal-growth model derives gestational age and personalized growth estimates from an international prospective cohort; it is tested against known visit intervals and independent fetal measurements rather than circular Naegele-rule comparison. Three independent validation strategies are described; reported interval estimation error is under three days for 20–30 week scans, with intended-population and measurement caveats.
